metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code setup: multi-agent team workflow + .NET/Angular stack conventions.

plugins.name: team-workflow
plugins.description: Multi-agent development workflow (PM, TECH_LEAD, ARCHITECT, FULLSTACK_DEVELOPER, QA, NAVIGATOR) with dispatcher, session-resume protocol, git rules, quality gate and generic review skills. Optional junior-senior profile: a junior developer implements normal subtasks, a senior developer implements pattern-setting ones, a fresh senior/tech-lead reviewer reviews before QA; milestones run subtask after subtask until the quality gate. Includes an independent QA agent, a lessons loop and an Opus project-planner that breaks the project into milestones. Includes a UI designer agent for landing pages and admin portals.

plugins.name: dotnet-angular
plugins.description: .NET (latest LTS) + EF Core + MariaDB + Angular (latest stable major) stack conventions, version policy and notes, pitfalls checklist, Angular UI/Syncfusion theming, and code-generation/review skills.
